title: What the Rain Keeps
poem: i.  Each morning I assemble the same face and hope it holds till dark.
ii.  What I miss most is a place I am not certain ever stood.
iii.  Somewhere a door I did not close is still open. I feel its draft in my hands.
iv.  I counted my breaths to be sure they were mine. The number changes.
v.  A photograph insists: this happened, this was warm.
colophon: drift and pull; a field that never settles the same way twice.
